title: Golden fixture manifest
description: Describes one fixture class in the compatibility corpus. This is the only schema that closes an object: the expect block is written by the suite author, not by a model, and every key a test reads is declared here so a typo fails loudly instead of silently disabling an assertion.

id.description: Fixture id. Subject-named: contract ids never appear in file or directory names.

contracts.description: Citation labels of the contracts this fixture exercises.

verdict.description: valid passes its schema; invalid must fail it; tolerated must fail the schema and still be read by the tolerant reader.

source.description: Provenance alias, never an original absolute path: either the synthetic marker or repository alias, workflow type and dated directory name.

writer_version.description: Plugin version that produced the sample, or null for synthetic fixtures.

strict_a2.description: Whether the dashboard data file in this fixture is strict JSON on the right-hand side, not only a bare-key literal.

schema.description: Schema this file validates against: a schema file name, optionally with a definition pointer. Null when the file has no schema and is checked by a lint instead.

expect.description: Closed on purpose so an unknown key is rejected rather than ignored.

error_path.description: The failing instance location must start with this.

error_keyword.description: The keyword the first error must come from.

degraded.description: Reasons the tolerant reader must report.

inventory_only.description: Directories below the compatibility floor: listed by name, never parsed, never resumed.

replay.description: How a captured hook payload must behave when piped back through the hook script.

state_fixture.description: Fixture whose files populate the temporary working directory before the replay.
